329: #===============================================================================
330: # BattleUseOnPokemon handlers
331: # For items used on Pokémon or on a Pokémon's move
332: #===============================================================================
333: ItemHandlers::BattleUseOnPokemon.add(:POTION, proc { |item, pokemon, battler, choices, scene|
334:   pbBattleHPItem(pokemon, battler, 20, scene)
335: })

337: ItemHandlers::BattleUseOnPokemon.copy(:POTION, :BERRYJUICE, :SWEETHEART)
